causal_contract: ERA5 covariates from 96h history only; no future reanalysis in conditioning or penalty

design.conditioning: arms era5_cond..combined_tail share the same 9 causal ERA5 features; only the penalty differs
design.penalty: MSE on implied clean estimate x1_hat = x_t + (1-t)v between Delta(x1_hat) and a train-only OLS physical prediction of the residual level change across the forecast origin
design.lambda_rule: auto-calibrated on first batch as 0.1*L_FM/R clipped to [0.01, 1.0], then frozen
design.coast_normal: approximate onshore unit vectors, see script
design.bathymetry: not explicit; per-region wind coefficient absorbs regional fetch effects; GEBCO deferred
